outlook.statement: Your Company is not as per the expectations in spite of continuous efforts to strengthen its stand in the market and assures you better performance in the years to come.

The Company expects FY 2026–27 to be a year of strategic consolidation, focusing on rebuilding its portfolio and strengthening its financial position. The future outlook is dependent on the pace of macroeconomic recovery, growth in advertising spends, and the Company's ability to leverage emerging platforms.

risks: Piracy of produced content under intellectual property rights can adversely affect revenues and profitability.
Piracy of the produced content, under the purview of intellectual property rights, can adversely affect revenues and profitability.
Market Volatility: The Company's performance is closely tied to advertising spends and broader economic conditions, which remain volatile.
Regulatory Risks: Frequent regulatory updates in broadcasting, taxation, and compliance increase complexity.
Intensifying competition from both domestic and global players in the streaming and entertainment space.
Shifting consumer preferences and rapid technological changes requiring continuous innovation.
